promise.en: By the end, you can say who everything belongs to.
promise.mn: Энэ хичээлийн төгсгөлд юм хэнийх болохыг хэлж чадна.

slides.say: Whose is it? Seven small words answer that question. And there is one trick with his and her that Mongolian speakers almost always get wrong. By the end you won't.

explain.en: One small word for each owner.

slides.say: Everything belongs to someone. English has one small word for each owner. Bat's bag: his bag. Saraa's phone: her phone. My book: my book. Instead of saying the owner's name again and again, we use one of these words.
slides.teach: The arrow always runs from the owner to the object. That direction becomes important on slide 6, so set it up now.

cards.en:
I have a dog.
**My** dog is small.
cards.mn: Надад нохой бий. Миний нохой жижиг.

cards.en:
She has a brother.
**Her** brother is 10.
cards.mn: Түүнд дүү бий. Түүний дүү 10 настай.

cards.en:
They have a car.
**Their** car is red.
cards.mn: Тэдэнд машин бий. Тэдний машин улаан.

cards.en:
We have a teacher.
**Our** teacher is kind.
cards.mn: Бидэнд багш бий. Манай багш сайхан сэтгэлтэй.

explain.mn: Хэний нохой вэ? Минийх: my dog.

slides.say: Read each twice. After each, ask and answer: whose dog? Mine, so my. Whose brother? Hers, so her. Whose car? Theirs, so their. Whose teacher? Ours, so our.
slides.teach: The words mine, hers, theirs and ours slip into your spoken answers naturally here; that is fine as exposure, but don't explain them in this video.

callout.en: his, her and its are all түүний in Mongolian.

slides.say: Each person has its own owner word. Name them now: possessive adjectives, хамаатуулах төлөөний үг. [click] Now look at the Mongolian column for these three. His, her, its: all түүний. Remember that; it matters in a minute. [click] And our and their.
slides.teach: Reading the person and the owner word side by side (I, my; he, his) helps memory more than learning the owner words alone. Point out that its has no apostrophe, and leave the reason for slide 7.

callout.en: Always right before a noun. Never with a or the.
callout.mn: Үргэлж нэр үгийн яг өмнө. a, the-тэй хамт хэрэглэхгүй.

slides.say: These words always stand right in front of a noun. [click] If there is an adjective, it goes in between: my new phone. [click] And they replace a and the. Never the my book. Just my book.
slides.teach: Mongolian миний ном already puts the owner first, so the order is easy for our students; the only new rule is "no a or the". If someone asks about This book is mine, that is a different word and a different lesson; for now these words always need a noun after them.

explain.en: his or her? Start from the owner, not the thing.
explain.mn: his үү, her үү? Юмнаас биш, эзнээс эхэлж бод.

slides.say: This is where Mongolian speakers go wrong, because түүний is the same for everyone. In English, his or her is decided by the owner. Bat's mother is a woman, but the owner is Bat, and Bat is a boy. So: his mother. [click] Saraa's father is a man, but the owner is Saraa. So: her father. [click] A thing or an animal owns with its.
slides.teach: Slow down; this is the slide the lesson exists for. Many students have also studied a language where the word follows the thing owned, which makes the mistake stronger. Keep pointing at the arrow: start at the owner, every time.

callout.en: Can you say "it is"? Write it's. If not, write its.
callout.mn: "It is" гэж хэлж болох уу? Тэгвэл it's. Болохгүй бол its.

slides.say: These pairs sound exactly the same but they are different words. The apostrophe always means a letter is missing: it's is it is. [click] So here is the test. Try saying it is instead. If the sentence still works, write it's. If it doesn't, write its.
slides.teach: This is a writing problem more than a speaking one. Native speakers make these mistakes too, so a student who gets them right writes better than many native speakers, which is worth saying aloud.

context.en: In Mongolian, түүний is the same for everyone.

mistakes.wrong:
The cat is hungry.
~~It's~~ bowl is empty.

right.en:
The cat is hungry.
**Its** bowl is empty.

slides.say: First: start from the owner. Bat is a boy, so his. [click] Second: try it is bowl. It doesn't work, so no apostrophe. [click] Third: no the in front.
slides.teach: Each mistake maps to one teaching slide (6, 7 and 5). Saying the test aloud on the second pair shows students how to use it on their own writing.

title.mn: Загвар эх: миний гэр бүлтэй танилц

lines.en: **My** father is Bold. **His** car is old, but he loves it.
lines.mn: Аав маань Болд. Түүний машин хуучин ч тэр түүндээ хайртай.

lines.en: **My** mother is Saraa. **Her** favourite food is buuz.
lines.mn: Ээж маань Сараа. Түүний дуртай хоол бол бууз.

lines.en: **My** brother and I share a room. **Our** room is small.
lines.mn: Дүү бид хоёр нэг өрөөнд байдаг. Манай өрөө жижиг.

lines.en: **My** grandparents are in the countryside. **Their** house is next to a river.
lines.mn: Өвөө эмээ маань хөдөө байдаг. Тэдний байшин голын хажууд.

lines.en: We have a dog. **Its** name is Khasar.
lines.mn: Манайд нохой бий. Түүний нэр Хасар.

slides.say: Read each line twice. For each highlighted word, name the owner: his, my father; her, my mother; our, my brother and me; their, my grandparents; its, the dog.
slides.teach: Every owner word appears except your. Buuz and the countryside keep it Mongolian, so it reads as the student's own family rather than a textbook family.

cards.mn: Эзэн нь шийднэ: Bat -> his mother

slides.say: Line one: the seven owner words, one for each person. My, your, his, her, its, our, their. They come right before a noun, and never after the. [click] Line two, the one a Mongolian speaker needs most: the owner decides. Start from the owner, every time. Bat is a boy, so his mother. [click] Line three: its with no apostrophe means түүний. It's means it is. If you can say it is, write the apostrophe. Close: Now you can say who everything belongs to, and write its and it's more correctly than many native speakers do.
slides.teach: Line two deserves the slowest delivery of the three.

slides.say: Closing line: Одоо энэ видеоны доорх дасгалаар мэдлэгээ шалгаарай.
slides.teach: Say the closing line, then hold the slide silently for three seconds.
